'''2010 Malastare Regionals Michael Bragg LS Mind What You Have Learned''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Michael Bragg]] at [[2010 Malastare Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|SE-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' The Trainer
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
